title: Moesha
description:
S4 E15 — I Love Moesha
When Moesha is once again rejected from her friends’ band, we enter a black and white parody of I LOVE LUCY wherein Lucy (Moesha) tries to get into Ricky’s show.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E16 — Home Is Where The Car Is
Moesha is disappointed when she is not appointed valedictorian of her senior class.  She discovers the boy who has been appointed is homeless.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E17 — Girl’s Night In
At a slumber party, Moesha and her friends reminisce (with clips from past episodes) about the past four years together.

S3 E4 — The Sing-Off
In charge of the big choir competition, Mary must make room in her have for the visiting choir's deacon, who is notoriously arrogant, thoughtless and pushy.

S3 E5 — And Baby Makes Three
Alarmed by Brenda and her friends' casual attitude about teen pregnancy, Mary uses some unusual methods to teach them a lesson about parenting that they'll never forget.

S3 E6 — Men's Club
Mary is delighted to learn that Lester will be named 'Man of the Year' by the local Men's Club...and distraught upon discovering she's not allowed to attend the special ceremony.

S3 E7 — Low Noon
To protest the opening of a sleazy club in her neighborhood, Mary dreams of running the varmints out of town.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E15 — Hai Karate
An unruly customer challenges Eddie to a fight; Nicolette and Holly try being roommates.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E16 — Jugglin'
While trying to help Holly, Malcolm finds himself juggling three dates at the same time.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E17 — Everynight Fever
Eddie's new band jeopardizes his work at the garage.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E18 — The Commercial
A TV commercial inadvertently turns Malcolm McGee's into a gay bar.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E19 — Whole Lotta Love Seat
When Eddie buys a new couch, he doesn't have enough money to pay the rent.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E8 — Jealousy
Invited to dinner at the Sanford home, Fred's fiancée Donna brings along a patient who is in her care. Fred is shocked when the man, apparently a healthy specimen, makes it obvious he thinks of Donna as more than a nurse.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E9 — Tooth Or Consequences
When Fred's attempt to have a hypnotist cure his toothache fails, Lamont insists his 'chicken' father go to the free clinic. Resigned to his fate, Fred goes with Lamont, but it's Lamont who is in for the unexpected medical complication.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E10 — The Shoot Out
When Lamont brings home an antique gun, Fred pulls the trigger and is surprised to learn the gun was loaded. Fred has just had an argument with his neighbor Herman Goldstein and the bullet careens through Goldstein's window.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E11 — The Puerto Ricans Are Coming! The Puerto Ricans Are Coming!
Fred is upset because his new neighbor is opening a competing junkyard -- but he's beside himself when he learns the neighbor is Puerto Rican. Fred vows to remedy the situation, over the strong objections of Lamont, who has become Julio's friend.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E12 — A Visit From Lena Horne
Fred spots Lena Horne's car in the parking lot while touring the NBC Studios and sneaks away to meet 'the first lady of his dreams.' When there is no answer to the knock on Lena's dressing room door, Fred enters and inspects her personal belongings.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E13 — Sanford & Son & Sister Makes Three
Fred's old flame Juanita brings her daughter Alice to dinner and it's love at first sight for Lamont. Juanita discloses a very delicate and difficult situation when she tells Fred that Alice is really his daughter -- and Lamont is thus dating his sister.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E22 — Uncle George And Aunt Louise
Louise makes it very clear to George that she doesn't want another child in the house, but he makes sure she gets one anyway, and he lives to regret it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E23 — George And Louise In A Bind
A burglar ties up George and Louise and gives them a night to remember in a special 90-minute episode. As they wait to be rescued, George and Louise re-live (by flashback) some of their most unforgettable and hilarious experiences.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E26 — Jenny's Thesis
Jenny Jefferson's thesis research on street gangs teaches her and her family a horrifying lesson in life...and death.
